---
name: Bug report
about: Capture a defect with clear context, evidence, impact, and acceptance criteria.
title: "Bug: "
labels: bug
---

## Summary
Describe the bug in one or two sentences.

## Context
Explain where this shows up and any relevant surrounding workflow, module, or user action.

## Expected Behavior
Describe what should happen.

## Actual Behavior
Describe what happens instead.

## Evidence / Repro
Include grounded reproduction notes, observed evidence, or examples when available.

## Suspected Cause
Include a grounded hypothesis only when supported by the prompt or lightweight repo context.

## Impact
Describe who or what is affected and why it matters.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The bug is addressed in the intended workflow
- [ ] The fix is verifiable through a concrete check, repro, or regression test
